scope: COV-020i: nominal approximation suffix -쯤 before particles/copulas, including existing bounded nominal suffixes. Whole lexical words remain; nominalized predicates and inner particles are not recursively split.
attribution: National Institute of Korean Language, Korean Basic Dictionary, September 2026 export. Every sense and attachment note, with up to two example groups per sense and selected additional examples.

notes: 일부 명사 또는 명사구 뒤에 붙는다.

examples: 그는 그까짓 공부해 봤자 다 소용이 없다며 학교를 그만두었다.
너는 대학생이 되어서 초등학생도 푸는 그까짓 문제도 못 풀어?

senses.definition: 아래쪽에 있던 것을 위쪽으로 올려서 붙이거나 가까이 가져가다.
(낮잡아 이르는 말로) 손을 들어 경례를 하다.
examples: 건물 입구에 있는 경비는 사장이 타고 있는 차에 경례를 올려붙였다.

senses.definition: 다리를 움직여 두 발을 번갈아 옮겨 놓는 동작.
두 발을 번갈아 옮겨 놓는 횟수를 세는 단위.
'그 시간에 가까운 때' 또는 '그 날짜에 가까운 때'의 뜻을 더하는 접미사.
notes: 시간이나 날짜를 나타내는 대다수 명사 또는 명사구 뒤에 붙는다.

senses.definition: ‘그 일에 걸리는 정도의 시간’의 뜻을 더하는 접미사.
notes: 일부 특정한 절차를 나타내는 한자 구성 뒤에 붙는다.

senses.definition: ‘무언가를 보기 위한 기구’의 뜻을 더하는 접미사.

text: 그까짓 감기쯤이야 하루만 쉬면 낫지 뭐.
이 별장은 스무 걸음쯤 떨어진 곳에 바다가 있어 경치가 무척 좋다.

source_access: Live entry 88691 could not be opened through the web tool; the pinned export supplies the attachment note and examples. Official NIKL FAQ 8216 independently describes noun/noun-phrase attachment and 사흘쯤/나흘쯤.

additional_sources.scope: Official FAQ: -쯤 after nouns/noun phrases; 사흘쯤 and 나흘쯤 mean approximate duration.

attachment_decisions: KRDict classifies -쯤 as 접사 after some nouns or noun phrases. Emit MorphemeKind::Suffix and source 88691, even though the KAIST token labels 쯤 as jxc. Do not alter the corpus annotation or claim it proves every candidate.

Existing nominal hypotheses and bounded 님/들/님+들/적 derivations can precede one outer 쯤. No semantic noun-class validator is claimed. The required stack examples cover honorific/plural nouns; 적 combinations remain unjudged.
Following particles and copulas reuse the known ㅁ boundary of 쯤. Numeric/foreign bases retain their spellings, but outer allomorphs do not need a pronunciation assumption for those bases.
Whole 그쯤/이쯤/저쯤 noun/adverb homonyms remain available under dictionary filtering. An unchanged lexical word and a decomposed suffix reading are separate candidates.

The suffix wrapper does not recursively peel itself or preceding particles/nominalized predicates. Existing 답다 paths do not acquire 쯤 derivation. These are scope limits pending attachment evidence, not universal linguistic prohibitions.
Temporal -경 and numeric -여 have different semantic restrictions; -경 also has an instrument homonym. They are not silently implemented as unrestricted approximation suffixes.

unjudged_followups.reason: Review generated lexical hypotheses and absent decompositions separately for nominalized predicates, inner particles, suffix order/repetition, relational semantics and 답다 attachment.
Quantity/time semantic restrictions and homonymous suffixes require separate rules and evidence.

lexical_fixture.adaptations: All lexical homonyms and senses; English equivalents and first example group per sense; omit WordForm, RelatedForm and export metadata.

remaining: COV-020 stays open for other suffix/composition and copular attachment classes.
Suffix POS is outside the 715-entry grammar-POS review queue; do not inflate its reviewed count.
Independent Korean review, fresh passages, semantic noun classes and contextual interpretation remain open.
